alkylation reagent: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
alkylation concentration: alkylated with 25 mM iodoacetamide (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
cleavage agent: digested overnight with 2 µg/mg LysC (Wako Laboratory Chemicals). Proteins were further diluted to 1.6 M urea and digested for 24 h with 10 µg/mg mass spectrometry grade trypsin (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
enrichment method: Samples were then immunoprecipitated using a PTMScan Ubiquitin remnant Motif (K-ε-GG) Kit (Cell Signaling Technologies)
instrument: analyzed by LC-MS/MS on a Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
ionization type: in conjunction with Proxeon Easy-nLC II HPLC (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and a Proxeon nanospray source
labeling: Cells were labeled by stable isotope labeling with amino acids in cell culture (SILAC)
reduction reagent: reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
reduction concentration: reduced with 10 mM dithiothreitol (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
